description: Options side by side, one criterion per row, with yes and no marks and the recommended option highlighted.

howToUse: Pass the option names in `options` and, in each row, one value per option in the same order: `true`, `false` or text.
`highlight` takes the index of the recommended option; it gets a badge and a tinted column.
Keep two to four options. On narrow screens the table scrolls sideways and the criterion column stays fixed.
alternatives: Rows of records to sort or filter: Table.
A choice the person makes right there: ChoiceCard or PlanCard.

keyboard.action: Scrolls the columns when the table is wider than the screen.
